verification_summary.balance_notes: Bird: 8 items, all T1 (pamphlet statement). Opponent Haschke has none because he filed no pamphlet statement (asterisk confirmed in county Candidate Index) and no other source was found — a documented non-filer gap, not unequal effort. Missed material: Bird's statement also names 'a practical local plan for homelessness as county resources dwindle' and 'a budget that doesn't balance itself without hard, concrete choices' as the other two of his three priorities; not collected (item p2 covers only the first). Incumbency left null (roster unfetchable); his statement lists only PSAC and Budget Committee as governmental experience, suggesting he is not a sitting councilor, but no roster confirms it.
